processErrors.lesson: A budget is a maximum, never a deployment target.
Do not add bets simply because a market family is underrepresented.
processErrors.note: Toronto F5 was promoted partly to increase F5 representation.

processErrors.lesson: Apply the same evidence standard across every market family.

Pitcher-outs UNDER/NO wagers based on workload need stronger evidence: an announced pitch cap, a documented return-from-injury restriction, a clearly documented manager usage restriction, or a robust pitch-count/batters-faced model.
processErrors.note: Klassen NO and Lauer NO both lacked this evidence and lost.

processErrors.lesson: Recent inning patterns alone are not enough to support a large edge.
Returning-from-IL pitcher overs should receive wider uncertainty bands and generally smaller stakes or passes.
Team totals remain valuable when they isolate the exact starter/bullpen weakness.
processErrors.note: Colorado TT and CWS TT both won by isolating specific pitching vulnerabilities.

processErrors.lesson: Multi-hit props require genuine PA/hit-distribution modeling.
Continue explicitly modeling F5 tie probability.
Preserve correlation penalties.

proposedInvestigations.lesson: Do not use one slate to overfit market-family preferences; do not infer from one slate that team totals are categorically superior -- sample remains small.
Add a settlement-consistency check when user-confirmed Kalshi player-prop payouts appear to conflict with official stat feeds.
